data.name: Mustashir
data.gender_notes: Mustashir is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: One who is settled or established
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'istasharah' which means to establish, settle, or maintain. In Islamic context, it refers to the belief that Allah (SWT) establishes and maintains the universe, and that the believer should strive to be steadfast in their faith and actions. The name Mustashir carries the meaning “One who is settled or established” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mustashir usually hope their child will grow to embody one who is settled or established and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name signifying one's commitment to Allah and the pursuit of a stable, virtuous life.
data.etymology: Mustashir belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “One who is settled or established.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mustashir total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: مستشير
in_arabic.meaning: مستشير يعني الشخص الذي يطلب المشورة أو يستشير أحدا في الأمور
in_arabic.long_meaning: المستشير في اللغة العربية هو الشخص الذي يلتمس المشورة أو الإرشاد من غيره في شؤون الحياة المختلفة، وقد وردت هذه الكلمة في القرآن الكريم في سياق طلب المشورة والتدبير للأمور، مما يعكس الأهمية النفسية والاجتماعية للمشورة في الثقافة الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: مستشر
in_urdu.meaning: مستشر کا مطلب ہے مشورہ لینے والا یا رہنمائی کرنے والا
in_urdu.long_meaning: مستشر نام کا مطلب ہے وہ شخص جو دوسروں سے مشورہ لیتا ہے یا کسی معاملے میں رہنمائی حاصل کرتا ہے۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقالید میں مشورہ اور مشاورت کی اہمیت کو ظاہر کرتا ہے، اور اس کا ذکر قرآن کریم میں بھی آیا ہے جہاں مشورہ اور سوچ بچار کر عمل کرنے کی تاکید کی گئی ہے۔

in_hindi.name: मुस्तशीर
in_hindi.meaning: मुस्तशीर का अर्थ है परामर्श लेने वाला या मार्गदर्शन करने वाला
in_hindi.long_meaning: मुस्तशीर नाम का अर्थ है वह व्यक्ति जो दूसरों से परामर्श लेता है या किसी मामले में मार्गदर्शन प्राप्त करता है। यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में परामर्श और विचार-विमर्श के महत्व को दर्शाता है, और इसका उल्लेख कुरआन में भी आया है जहां सोच-विचार कर कार्य करने की تاکید की गई है।

in_pashto.name: مستشير
in_pashto.meaning: مستشير د مشورې اخيستونکی يا لارښودونکی معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: مستشير نوم دا معنی لري چې هغه څوک د نورو څخه مشوره اخلي یا په یوه مسئله کې لارښودنه ترلاسه کوي. دا نوم د مشورې او مشورې غوښتنې اهمیت په اسلامي کلتور کې څرګندوي، او د قرآن کریم په آيتونو کې يې راغلی دی چې د کارونو پر مخه د مشورې او غور اوخور کولو ټینګار کوي.

in_english.name: Mustashir
in_english.meaning: Mustashir means one who seeks consultation or guidance
in_english.long_meaning: The name Mustashir originates from the Arabic root 'sh-r-y' which means 'to seek consultation'. In Islamic tradition, seeking advice and consultation is highly recommended as mentioned in the Quran. The name reflects a person's willingness to seek guidance and act wisely, embodying values of humility and social intelligence.

historical_references.reference: Mustashir Billah (r. 1118-1136 AD) was the founder of the Shahi dynasty in Kashmir. He was a descendant of the Arab general Qais Abdul Rasheed who invaded Kashmir in 712 AD. Mustashir Billah's rule is considered a golden age for the region due to its flourishing arts, literature, and culture.
historical_references.context: Founder of Shahi dynasty in Kashmir, known for cultural achievements.

historical_references.reference: Mustasim Billah (r. 1253-1255 AD) was the last independent Sultan of the Sultanate of Bengal. He ruled during the Mongol invasions of Bengal. Mustasim Billah was defeated by Hulagu Khan in the Battle of Khalibar in 1255 AD, resulting in the end of the Sultanate of Bengal and the beginning of Mongol rule in the region.
historical_references.context: Last independent Sultan of Bengal, defeated by Mongols ending Sultanate.
